newsitem.title: USA: Plains feedlot cattle market quiet - feedyards.
newsitem.headline: Plains feedlot cattle market quiet - feedyards.

text.p: U.S. Plains direct cattle markets early Monday were quiet as packers and cattle owners positioned themselves and waited to see what happens with CME live cattle futures and beef prices, feedlot sources said.
"Buyers are just sitting around with hands in their pockets and looking around, but I don't have any orders," one Panhandle feedlot operator said.
When packers do present bids, they are expected at $70.00 per cwt against asking levels of $72.00, unchanged from last week's moderate sales, the feedlot sources said.
